text: Fix 1: per-cell temporal spread gate in cell_median (configurable, replaces a range cap); noisy cells are unknown, never lethal, never a drop or step edge.
Fix 2: step height from the p50 of the edge band plus per-cell class hysteresis (N of M frames, configurable); the 5 cm box stays an obstacle, a 3 cm sill stays a warning.
Fix 3: colour-mismatch clusters are warning-only, never lethal.
Fix 4: single-point lethal marks removed: unclustered lethal points need >= 2 points or persistence over frames.
Fix 5: warning areas from per-odom-cell hysteresis; costmap_zones keys areas by cell instead of the 3 s TTL union and publishes only on change.
Fix 6: plane smoothing fit.smoothing 0.5 -> 0.2 after the spread gate.

Fix 7: ramp rule max_slope_deg 15 validated against the tilt_guard error limits, and a robust slope estimate for sparse surfaces (robust fit, minimum support, hysteresis) so a 14 deg ramp is a stable warning.

Fix 8: static runbook (no driving, head moves allowed) on the user's scene, 2 min per object: box obstacle >= 95%, ramp warning >= 90% with slope within +-3 deg of 14, board no lethal, empty floor 0 lethal points p95, warning-area churn < 10%; numbers recorded. Executed by the orchestrator after deploy.
User ground truth: the box is exactly 5 cm (an obstacle under the 1/3-wheel rule); the 25 cm / 63 mm ramp is a safe skew (a warning).
